name: agricoventas
description: Plataforma de comercio electrónico para productos agrícolas

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -c "blue,green" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && powershell -Command "Set-Location -Path backend; npm install; Set-Location -Path ../frontend; npm install"
